test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

They said to him, “Do not jump into the pond today.”

options.text: They told him from jumping into the pond the same day.
They told him not to jump into the pond that day.
They told him to jump into the pond the previous day.
They told him not jumped into the pond that day.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** They said to him, “Do not jump into the pond today.”
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Converts the command into a reporting statement.
 
 
• The imperative verb "Do not jump" changes to "not to jump."
 
• The phrase "into the pond today" changes to "into the pond that day" to maintain the same timeframe.
 
• "Said to" changes to "told."
 
 
 
• **Correct Format:** The direct speech command is turned into a reported command in indirect speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They told him not to jump into the pond that day."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "They told him from jumping into the pond the same day." – Incorrect preposition and awkward construction.
 
• **Option 3:** "They told him to jump into the pond the previous day." – Incorrectly changes the command to the opposite meaning and wrong timeframe.
 
• **Option 4:** "They told him not jumped into the pond that day." – Incorrect verb form and awkward construction.
